description_en: Converts a pay-as-you-go ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance to a subscription instance
description_zh: 将按量付费的MongoDB实例转换为包年包月（预付费）实例
name: TransformToPrePaid

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36
parameters.help_zh: 预付费时长，单位为月。取值范围为1~9、12、24、36
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether automatic payment is enabled for the order. Valid values:

true: enables automatic payment for the order.
false: disables automatic payment for the order. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85052.html.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付订单，取值：

true：自动支付订单。
false：手动支付订单，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85052.html。

默认值为true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The additional parameter for business information
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal upon expiration. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
到期后是否自动续费，取值：

true：自动续费。
false：手动续费。

默认值为false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:
default or null: uses a coupon. This is the default value.
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: does not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. It can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without calling the operation. The system checks items such as request parameters, request format, service limits, and available resources. If the request fails the dry run, the system returns an error. If the request passes the dry run, the system returns the DryRunOperation error code.
false: sends the request and performs the operation if the request passes the check. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run
